size_basis: L x W x H mm, set by flow_graph/param/ess_tf.py (X-MFG-43): the 47-bay rack hall (47 bays of stack-over-tank at 1100 x 850 mm pitch); the placement seed block for ZNBR2 stays the 1800 x 1200 x 1600 mm study box and under-books this machine - the floor-space reservation is the named consequence (ZNBR2 WORK_ORDER W12)
solids_note: one compound of closed solids: plinth, posts, tanks (wall solids), the bonded plate-pack field envelopes, end plates, tie rods, lifting beams, bus flats, purchased envelopes and the nozzle stubs; every union partner overlaps volumetrically, so the mesh reads back closed and manifold

a_cell.basis: A-CELL: plate count, size, pitch and active area match the design block (ess_tf, X-MFG-43, A-M-456); the model carries the booked area (j.A = current closes on it); the field draws as the bonded per-module plate-pack envelope (plates + separator lands at the booked 6 mm pitch; the drawn envelope carries the booked active area) - the individual sheets are BOM rows 2 and 4; the duty section 2 states no plate geometry, so the purge-basis area is the authority (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

electrolyte_holdup_L.basis: reported from the model tank inside volume against the design figure (A-M-457); no residence time is derived - the duty section 2 claims no holdup (A-VES rule)

placement_hold: the placement seed block for ZNBR2 is the 1800 x 1200 x 1600 mm study box; this machine books 7900 x 6050 x 1970 mm of rack hall plus the electrolyte farm - floor-space reservation is the named consequence (duty section 2 and WORK_ORDER W12; nothing is resized)

bus.bar: 1 x 20 x 6.3 copper flat per stack terminal (AQS-BUS-001 class method; POWER.md states no ZNBR2 bus section)
bus.basis: AQS-BUS-001 class method; POWER.md states no ZNBR2 bus section, so the bar follows the class at the stack current (A-CELL bus rule)
